items.text: 200 grams of pearl barley, rinsed until the water runs clear
Two large leeks, washed and sliced into thin rounds

blocks.text: Soften the leeks in butter for ten minutes, then add the barley and two litres of vegetable stock.
Simmer for forty minutes, season with pepper, and finish with a handful of chopped parsley.
